authorized_action: One fixed complete original-witness classification at tau on all original roots/leaves, preserving arbitrary separated sublevel coverage and source provenance. No automatic overlap scan.
domain: Every h_r >= 17/20 with F9(h) < tau; not a minimizer restriction and not a claim that every low-energy window is separated.
threshold_margin_identity: M_tau = M_original - SLOPE * delta_numerator, exactly once; source AST identity must be checked.
source_budget_rule: Report actual baseline bytes and actual output encoding sizes. New formal consumer, whole flattened source and kernel runtime remain unknown unless measured; an unknown or failed complete budget forbids proceeding to proof batches and does not make this research classification a compliant upload.
stops: Input, all-node trace, counts, source AST threshold identity or cursor mismatch
Any omitted terminal, reflection used as energy payment, changed witness or new query
after_execution: Freeze results and independently audit classification/closed geometry before deciding whether a separately authorized full four-orientation DBM opportunity scan is warranted. Preserve failed attempts; do not retry a different threshold.
